name: Forgejo
description: Self-hosted Git for your NAS: repositories, issues, pull requests, releases and a web editor, reachable on your LAN or through the Domains package. Give the Code Editor and Git Diff apps a remote to push to. Repositories live in a package volume, so no share permissions are involved; the first visit creates the administrator account and locks the instance.
author: SyncHot
changelog: 1.0.1: the web UI moved to host port 3005 — port 3000 is taken by many other compose projects, which made the first install fail with “port is already allocated”. 1.0.0: first release — Forgejo 17.0.2 pinned, SQLite in a package volume, web UI on port 3000 and SSH on 2222 (so it never collides with the NAS sshd). The first visit runs the installer with the database pre-filled; create the administrator account there. Self-registration is disabled.
